common.learning_step_origin: actual original start; includes every restart in that family
common.source_failure: fallback to normal; its steps count toward normal
common.learning_clock: existing learning-step units including terminal turns; extra saved-source TD updates logged separately
common.cumulative_steps_policy: prefer the side with fewer completed steps; ties prefer fewer in-flight families then a saved alternating cursor
common.ratio_limitations: a 50% archive-step target is not guaranteed during source starvation or with unfinished multiworker families

comparison.B_vs_Bprime: effect of updating the saved source afterstate once per archive family
comparison.B_vs_Bdoubleprime: effect of allocating learning steps instead of requesting archive starts with probability 0.5
